## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue or plan, if
there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran, their results, and any gaps. Include `Release` and
`ReleaseLean` when the change affects the supported package families.

## Compatibility

Describe any effects on public APIs, map publication, guide lifetimes,
controller ownership, or serialization. Include measured results for performance
claims.
